Name: Demonic_Hellfire_Aura
Description: Emits a burning aura that deals constant fire damage to nearby players

Name: Demonic_Beguiling
Description: When taking damage from a player, charm them for 2 seconds. Players cannot deal direct damage to you while charmed.

Name: Demonic_Infernal_Sacrifice
Description: Sacrifice nearby allies to heal yourself and gain temporary damage buffs.

Name: Demonic_Unholy_Sigils
Description: Create a large demonic sigil on the ground. Allies in this sigil cannot be killed.

Name: Demonic_Abyssal_Aura
Description: This enemy is surrounded by an aura of pure demonic energy. Players within the aura's radius will have their Demonic resistance reduced by 25%.

Name: Demonic_Sacrificial_Bond
Description: All damage taken is redirected and divided among nearby allies.

Name: Demonic_Inferno_Charge
Description: Channel for 2 seconds, then dash towards the player at rapid speeds. Deals AoE damage on hit and leave a lingering DoT over the path traveled.

Name: Demonic_Infernal_Brand
Description: Apply a stacking "Infernal Brand" debuff on hit to the player. When the brand reaches 5 stacks, it explodes, dealing a large amount of damage to the player and consuming all stacks.

Name: Death_Haunting
Description: A spectral copy of this enemy is created on death

Name: Death_Grave_Touch
Description: Deal more damage to players with less than 50% health.

Name: Death_Undying_Will
Description: Enemies resurrect after death with reduced health but increased damage output.

Name: Death_Soul_Eater
Description: Completely ignores player energy shields.

Name: Death_Shadow_Step
Description: Become invisible when not attacking.

Name: Death_Spectral_Shift
Description: Phase in and out of existence, becoming immune to damage.

Name: Death_Lingering_Decay
Description: Enemies leave behind necrotic zones that reduce healing to players standing in them.

Name: Death_Final_Curse
Description: Upon death, curse the player for 5 seconds, causing them to take damage when using abilities.

Name: Death_Funeral_Pyre
Description: Summon deadly bone pyres when hit that explode if not destroyed quickly.

Name: Death_Soul_Tether
Description: Transfer a portion damage taken to the player as health degeneration over time.

Name: Death_Mortal_Reminder
Description: Attacks apply a debuff that prevents the player from being healed above their current HP for 4 seconds. It caps your "recovery ceiling."

Name: War_Commander
Description: Inspires allies, increasing their stats by 20%.

Name: War_Battle_Cry
Description: Emit a terrifying shout that reduces the player's resistances or armor for 5 seconds.

Name: War_Armored_Juggernaut
Description: Gain 50% armor

Name: War_Drums_of_War
Description: Increases nearby allies move speed and attack speed by 50%.

Name: War_Shield_Wall
Description: Take 75% less damage from attacks from the front.

Name: War_Artillery_Barrage
Description: Call down explosive projectiles in random areas near the player.

Name: War_Battle_Scarred
Description: Become more dangerous, gaining increased critical strike chance and damage resistance.

Name: War_1_On_1
Description: Summon an arena around you and a nearby player that lasts until one of you is defeated. All allies in the area of the arena are consumed to empower you with 50% of all of their stats.

Name: War_Phalanx
Description: Gains 10% damage reduction for every other enemy within 5 meters. Forces you to pull them apart or use high AoE.

Name: Pestilence_Contagion
Description: DOTs and debuffs are mirrored back onto the player.

Name: Pestilence_Toxic_Trail
Description: Enemies leave behind a poison cloud as they move.

Name: Pestilence_Poison_Eater
Description: Healed by all poison damage.

Name: Pestilence_Toxic_Bond
Description: Being hit applies a poison stack to the player.

Name: Pestilence_Blistering_Rot
Description: Attacks from these enemies cause blisters that burst after 3 seconds, dealing damage and reducing healing.

Name: Pestilence_Corruptive_Sludge
Description: Leave behind sludge pools on death that significantly reduce movement speed.

Name: Pestilence_Parasite_Host
Description: Spawn parasitic worms on death that burrow into nearby allies and upgrade them to the next rarity.

Name: Pestilence_Living_Hive
Description: Every 5 seconds, spawns 3 tiny, fast-moving insects that don't deal much damage but each reduce your armor/resistances by 5% while they are attached to you.

Name: Pestilence_Virulent_Blood
Description: When hit, sprays acid in a cone toward the attacker. Melee builds have to "circle-strafe" this enemy constantly.

Name: Famine_Starving_Aura
Description: Emit an aura that reduces healing and health regeneration effects by 50%.

Name: Famine_Withering_Touch
Description: Attacks reduce player damage output for a short duration.

Name: Famine_Scavenger
Description: Consume corpses, healing yourself and nearby allies.

Name: Famine_Leeching_Curse
Description: Steal player buffs and gain their effects for 5 seconds.

Name: Famine_Withering_Curse
Description: Apply a stacking debuff that temporarily reduces the player’s total damage output.

Name: Famine_Sapping_Presence
Description: Nearby players' mana regen, health regen, and shield regen become yours while they remain in range.

Name: Famine_Pickpocket
Description: Steals a random item from the player's inventory when dealing damage. Run away after stealing 2 or 3 items. Drop all stolen loot on death.

Name: Celestial_Divine_Aegis
Description: Enemy gains a divine shield when below 50% HP, reducing all damage taken by 75%.

Name: Celestial_When_reduced_to_30_HP_summon_celestial
ModifierName: When reduced to 30% HP, summon celestial
Description: When reduced to 30% HP, summon celestial spirits that provide healing over time and immunity to crowd control

Name: Celestial_Lawbringer
Description: Suppress one of the player's active abilities for 10 seconds.

Name: Celestial_Zealous_Martyr
Description: On death, buff all nearby allies with 50% increased damage, movespeed, and attack speed.

Name: Celestial_Holy_Binding
Description: Connect a chain to the player that reduces their movespeed by 50%. If the player moves too far away, they takes massive divine damage as the chain snaps.

Name: Celestial_Divine_Intervention
Description: When dropping below 10% hp, become invulnerable for 5 seconds.

Name: Celestial_Cleansing_Light
Description: Purge one buff from the player every 3 seconds. If there are no buffs to remove, instead deal 10% of the player's max hp in true damage.

Name: Celestial_Judgment_Loop
Description: Places a circle on the ground. If you leave the circle before 4 seconds pass, you are struck by lightning. If you stay, you are safe from the lightning but vulnerable to the enemy's melee.

Name: Chaos_Randomized_Immunity
Description: Randomly switch between damage immunities every 3 seconds.

Name: Chaos_Chaotic_Barrier
Description: Temporarily gain a random buff when attacked.

Name: Chaos_Warp_Reflex
Description: Randomly teleport 4 meters away when hit.

Name: Chaos_Split_Reality
Description: Create duplicate illusions that explode if attacked.

Name: Chaos_Anarchy_Aura
Description: Randomly buff or debuff nearby allies and players alike

Name: Chaos_Mutating_Form
Description: Gain a random new ability or attack every 5 seconds.

Name: Chaos_Temporal_Shifter
Description: This enemy's movement, cast, and attack speed will randomly increase or decrease every few seconds

Name: Chaos_Mirror_Image
Description: Every time you hit this enemy, there is a 10% chance it swaps positions with you.

Name: Void_Voidlings
Description: Split into two copies when taking more than 10% health in damage.

Name: Void_Void_Rift
Description: Enemies create small void zones that deal heavy damage over time to players who remain in them.

Name: Void_Nullification_Field
Description: Nearby players are unable to use non basic attack abilities

Name: Void_Crawling_Insanity
Description: Attacks inflict madness.

Name: Void_Echoes_of_the_Void
Description: After 3 seconds, reflect 25% of damage taken back to the player.

Name: Void_All_Consuming
Description: Inflict the player with 2 stacks of void splinter when hit.

Name: Void_Touch_of_Nothing
Description: Hitting a player applies a stack of Touch of Nothing. Anytime the player would gain any kind of buff, instead a stack is consumed to negate that buff completely.

Name: Void_Corrupted
Description: The enemy is slowly corrupting the ground around them. Standing in the corrupted ground will deal a small amount of damage over time and will also disable player abilities as long as they are standing in the corruption.

Name: Void_Event_Horizon
Description: When this enemy dies, it leaves a small black hole that lasts 5 seconds. It doesn't deal damage, but it sucks in all nearby loot and gold, destroying it if you don't pick it up fast enough.

Name: Generic_Unyielding
Description: Immunity to crowd control effects

Name: Generic_Bloodthirsty
Description: Heal for 10% of the damage dealt to the player.

Name: Generic_Relentless
Description: Regenerate health over time unless damaged in the past 2 seconds.

Name: Generic_Shielder
Description: Spawn with an additional shield equal to 50% of maximum health, which regenerates if not damaged within 5 seconds.

Name: Generic_Horde_Leader
Description: On death, all nearby enemies become enraged, increasing their attack speed and movement speed for 5 seconds.

Name: Generic_Phasewalker
Description: Teleport short distances every few seconds.

Name: Generic_Titanic_Resolve
Description: 50% more health.

Name: Generic_Perfect_Aim
Description: Attacks cannot be dodged.

Name: Generic_Overpowered
Description: Always crits

Name: Generic_Thorns_of_Glass
Description: Reflects 100% of damage taken, but the enemy only has 1 HP. You have to use a "chip damage" source or a DoT to kill it without killing yourself.
